2607.01282.title: Domain Knowledge Based Temporal-Spatial Graph Convolution Network for ECG Recognition
2607.01282.paper_summary: In light of strides in Arti cial Intelligence (AI) and its wide spread application, challenges persist in the interpretability of AI models, particularly within specialized domains like healthcare, such as electro cardiograph (ECG) recognition. Rather than relying solely on end-to-end convolutional neural networks, this paper introduces a novel approach using a domain knowledge-based graph convolution network for ECG recognition. Key landmarks points of PRQST, vital to ECG interpreta tion, are incorporated as domain knowledge. The double-stream directed graph is employed to model both intra and inter ECG cycles. Speci cally, spatial directed graphs capture the positional relationships among key points, while temporal directed graphs delineate temporal dependencies between adjacent cycles in extended ECG sequences. Experimental re sults on the First Chinese ECG Intelligent Competition dataset, which speci cally classify ECG into nine categories, prove the e cacy of the proposed model. The overall average F1 score is 88.1%, the average F1 score of rare categories is 76.3%, both outperform the state-of-the-art models. The introduction of domain knowledge did enhance the detec tion performance, especially for rare categories.
2607.01282.paper_summary_zh: 鑒於人工智慧（AI）的進步及其廣泛應用，AI模型的可解釋性在專業領域如醫療保健中仍然面臨挑戰，例如心電圖（ECG）識別。本文提出了一種新穎的方法，使用基於領域知識的圖卷積網絡來進行ECG識別，而不僅僅依賴端到端的卷積神經網絡。PRQST的關鍵地標點作為領域知識被納入，對ECG解釋至關重要。雙流有向圖被用來建模ECG週期內部和之間的關係。具體而言，空間有向圖捕捉關鍵點之間的位置信息，而時間有向圖則描述相鄰週期在擴展ECG序列中的時間依賴性。在第一屆中國心電圖智能競賽數據集上的實驗結果，該數據集專門將ECG分類為九個類別，證明了所提模型的有效性。整體平均F1分數為88.1%，稀有類別的平均F1分數為76.3%，均超越了最先進的模型。引入領域知識確實提高了檢測性能，特別是對於稀有類別。
